scope: Source identity, Phase18 ownership/preservation and observed host drift only. No execution PASS, deployment, pristine baseline or whole-phase completion is inferred.

observedStart.note: Observed after delegation and initial Phase 18 edits. This is not a pristine pre-edit baseline; Phase 17 frozen inputs and retained source are the prior-stage reference.

sharedRegistrationMeaning: Only required Phase18 cfg(test), suite and wrapper/parser registration markers are asserted. Shared current bytes may differ from the tested candidate and are not certified as executed; policy and execution results are separate evidence.

provenanceSelection.limitation: Deltas cover the union of each recorded selector output. Selection additions/removals do not establish a file was physically added/deleted. Unselected work and external ownership are not exhaustively certified.

dependencies.limitation: Identical Cargo manifest/lock preserve the prior dependency identities and recorded metadata. No new vulnerability, license or legal audit is claimed.
